court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Sangli (Misc. Application Nos. 168 of 2003 and 131 of 2006)
case_name: Mr.Draupadaa@Draupadi Jaydeo ... vs Smt. Indubai D/O. Kashinath Shivram ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Draupada @ Draupadi Jaydeo Pawar and Others
parties.respondent_defendant: Indubai d/o. Kashinath Shivram Chavan and Another

facts_of_case: Draupada and Indubai both claimed to be wives of the deceased Jaydeo Pawar. Draupada applied for Letters of Administration and claimed that Jaydeo had married her in 1979, while Indubai claimed their marriage was solemnized in 1981. The trial court decided in favour of Indubai's maintenance application under Section 125 of Code of Criminal Procedure.

legal_principles.principle: The silence of a party about a fact cannot be given any weightage and can be considered as a circumstance against that party.
legal_principles.held: Thus, silence of Jaydeo about his first marriage with Draupada in the written statement cannot be given any weightage and a circumstance against Draupada.

legal_principles.principle: The fact of a marriage can be proved by evidence and not just mere denials.
legal_principles.held: His evidence could not be dislodged in the cross-examination by putting mere denials.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the judgment and order dated 17th February, 2010 passed by the Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Sangli is set aside.
